subtext: Each collection remembers its own reading preference.
title: Group Features and Roadmap independently
statement: As a Product Manager, I can choose a separate grouping for Features and Roadmap, so I can review delivered capabilities and upcoming priorities from different perspectives.
overview: Grouping changes presentation rather than feature ownership. Themes are shared categories with optional explanatory content; labels are lightweight shared categories. Persona grouping derives from the current stories. No grouping choice creates product records.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each nonempty collection offers None, Persona, Label and Milestone grouping, and also offers Theme when themes exist.
Changing the Roadmap grouping preserves the Features grouping and vice versa, including after opening a feature or story page.
A feature with several labels appears in each applicable label group and every occurrence opens the same canonical feature page.
Label grouping retains unlabeled features, and milestone grouping retains features with no milestone.
Feature and Roadmap directories display and can filter by current shared label and milestone names.
